name: Robin AI
summary: Legal intelligence platform and services for reviewing and searching contracts.
description: Robin AI offers a legal intelligence platform that answers questions from a company's contracts and documents, along with contract review and search, and legal services delivered by its team. It is aimed at enterprise legal teams. Access is through a demo; no public pricing was found. The company publishes news, resources and customer stories. Its platform is described as legal AI for enterprise.
